verdict.rationale: The Admin SDK Directory API is documented with paginated user listing (docs-5), user/group management guides (docs-22, docs-23), Cloud Identity API for provisioning and dynamic groups (docs-7, docs-30), and Reports API for auditing (docs-6/24) — covering much of the 'users, groups, provisioning' surface. However, explicit REST documentation for 'app assignments' (SSO/app access) is thin, mostly console-level SAML/SSO setup guides rather than REST endpoints, and there is no clear documentation of auth flows (OAuth scopes) or a discoverable machine-readable spec (probe shows 404 for openapi.json and llms.txt), limiting programmability visibility. Missing for 10: explicit groups REST endpoint documentation, app-assignment REST API evidence, clear auth/OAuth scope docs, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec.
